last.verdict: Investors cheered a big profit beat and a higher full-year outlook.

reasons.label: Raised 2026 outlook
reasons.text: Full-year profit forecast lifted $0.20 to about $1.70 a share; EBITDA about $2.55B.

reasons.label: Big earnings beat
reasons.text: Adjusted profit of $1.12 a share beat the roughly $0.93 analysts expected.

reasons.label: Fuller ships, lower costs
reasons.text: Ships ran 106.5% full versus 104% guided; another $100M in savings found.

story: Guidance had been sliding all year. In May, Norwegian cut its 2026 profit forecast on fuel costs and weak European demand. In July it trimmed again to about $1.50 and the stock fell. This report reversed the trend.
